title: Understanding Non-response Bias
text: Non-response bias occurs when the individuals who do not respond to a survey differ in significant ways from those who do respond. Think about how the method of selecting every fifth student might lead to certain groups being underrepresented.

title: Identifying Potential Bias
text: Which of the following best describes non-response bias?
choices: > B. When the survey questions are leading or biased
> C. When the sample size is too small to draw conclusions
> D. When the survey is conducted at an inconvenient time
A. When the responses collected do not represent the entire population

title: Sampling Method Consideration
text: Consider how the sampling method might affect who is included in the survey. Are there any groups of students who might be less likely to attend discussion sections?

title: Evaluating the Sampling Scheme
text: What is a potential drawback of selecting every fifth student in a discussion section?
choices: > B. It might miss students who do not attend discussions
> C. It is too random to be effective
A. It ensures a diverse sample
